response.overview: The film follows a quarrelsome man who seems to be constantly fighting with everyone around him. He gets angry easily, argues over small things, and has difficulty dealing with other people.  The movie is immersive and calm, with few dialogues. Much of the story is told through his actions, expressions, the environment, and a soft symphonic soundtrack.  Despite his aggressive personality, there are quiet moments when we see a different side of him. Alone, he becomes thoughtful and distant, revealing that there may be something deeper behind his anger.  The film moves slowly, allowing the viewer to experience his routine and his world through silence, music, and atmosphere, while the few conversations he has become important moments in his story.
